root_idea.summary: The root expresses the gathering or settling of something into a compact state, especially by remaining close to the ground.
root_idea.development: This orientation extends to the body or person as a gathered physical form and to creatures that crouch, lie, or remain fixed on the ground; further lexical branches concern collected matter and other settled or compact forms.

senses.definition: Remaining pressed to the ground or lying motionless; in Quranic usage, people left as fallen bodies in their dwellings.
senses.usage_conditions: The attested form is the masculine plural جَاثِمِينَ. In the Quranic scenes of punishment, the posture may be rendered “fallen prone,” “motionless,” or, by contextual implication, “extinct” or “dead.” The expression is figurative of people remaining in place, from the posture of a creature sitting or clinging to the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cling to the ground, remain in one’s place, or fall upon the breast; of a bird, hare, gazelle, camel, jerboa, or person, to assume such a crouching or grounded posture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle can also describe sitting on the legs like a bird. The listed animals are attestations of usage, not an exclusive limitation on the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of seed-produce, to rise a little from the ground; of a palm-tree raceme, for its unripe or ripening dates to become somewhat large while it remains in place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural and botanical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the night, to become half spent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or tropical usage said of the night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect clay or mould, earth or dust, and ashes.
Collected clay, mould, earth, dust, or ashes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the material gathered into a mass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a bird, hare, or similar animal remain pressed to the ground or to confine it so that it may be shot and killed; also, to turn an animal onto its side for slaughter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative slaughtering or hunting construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird, to mount the female for copulation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sexual construction explicitly said of a bird.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The body with its limbs or members; also a person or bodily form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the physical body or, in one attested usage, the person as a bodily figure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The water itself, its middle, or the place where water has collected.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized expression concerning a body or central collection of water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An incubus or nightmare: what comes upon a sleeping person at night and prevents speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A term for a nocturnal oppressive condition.
A specialized lexical designation, reported as a derived usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hill such as one called أَكَمَةٌ.
A sedentary person who stays in a settled region, house, or tent and does not travel; also one who sleeps much and does not travel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative characterization derived from remaining fixed in one place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stupid or dull person, lacking intelligence, penetration, sharpness, vigor, or effectiveness in carrying out affairs.
A forbearing or clement person, especially a chief or person of rank or quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attested evaluative usage for a person of status or character.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The stars composing the constellation of the Scorpion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical term; the constellation is also called البُرُكُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where a bird or other creature clings to the ground, keeps to the ground, or falls upon its breast; especially the seat or form of a hare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A locative noun, with a particular application to a hare’s resting place or posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal confined or set up to be shot at, stoned, or otherwise killed; especially an animal killed in this manner and then eaten.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized hunting or slaughter practice, explicitly including birds, hares, sheep, goats, and other animals.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Duplicate agricultural branch synthesized with the corresponding verbal entry.
Duplicate palm-raceme branch synthesized with the corresponding verbal entry.

cautions: The Quranic public headword is normalized to the singular active-participle citation form جَاثِمٌ, while all five Quran occurrences are the masculine plural جَاثِمِينَ.
In the Quranic usage, “dead” or “extinct” describes the contextual result of being left motionless; the core lexical image is remaining pressed to the ground or lying prone.
